title: What Drives LLM Self-Reflection? A Controlled Ablation of Uncertainty Routing in Armed Conflict Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.12322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-reflection is widely assumed to improve LLM reasoning, yet which component drives the gain remains poorly understood. We present a controlled six-condition ablation isolating four components of LLM self-reflection: evidence exposure, diagnostic scaffolding, taxonomy vocabulary, and action routing. Two precise null results converge on a single mechanism. First, structured diagnostic questions add no measurable value over unstructured reflection ($\text{F1} = 0.296$ vs $0.297$, $p = 1.000$, 95\% CI $[-0.041, +0.040]$). Second, presenting the full uncertainty taxonomy while collapsing the action space to a single generic action also adds no value ($\Delta\text{F1} = +0.008$, overlapping 95\% CIs), ruling out taxonomy vocabulary as the mechanism. translated_title: 什么驱动大语言模型自我反思？武装冲突预测中不确定性路由的控制消融研究
translated_abstract: 自我反思被广泛认为能提升大语言模型的推理能力，但究竟是哪个组成部分带来了这种提升，目前仍知之甚少。我们提出了一种受控的六条件消融实验，隔离了LLM自我反思的四个组成部分：证据暴露、诊断性脚手架、分类词汇表和行动路由。两个精确的零结果汇聚于一个单一机制。首先，结构化诊断问题相比非结构化反思没有增加可测量的价值（$\text{F1} = 0.296$ 对比 $0.297$，$p = 1.000$，95% 置信区间 $[-0.041, +0.040]$）。其次，在将行动空间压缩为单一通用行动的同时呈现完整的不确定性分类表，也没有增加价值（$\Delta\text{F1} = +0.008$，95% 置信区间重叠），从而排除了分类词汇表作为机制。类型化行动路由提供了一致的正向收益（$\text{F1} = 0.379$ 对比 $0.296$）；控制分类词汇表的保守估计为 $\Delta\text{F1} = +0.075$，且t...
tldr: 通过受控消融实验，发现LLM自我反思的收益主要来自类型化行动路由，而非结构化诊断问题或分类词汇表。
en_tdlr: Through controlled ablation, the gain of LLM self-reflection primarily comes from typed action routing, not structured diagnostic questions or taxonomy vocabulary.
